scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: COBOL free-format loop and numeric editing
checks.code:
identification division.
program-id. museum.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 n pic 9(4) binary.
01 total pic 9(6) binary value 0.
01 shown pic Z(5)9.
procedure division.
perform varying n from 1 by 1 until n > 10
 add n to total
end-perform
move total to shown
display function trim(shown)
goback.

checks.name: COBOL intrinsic function and edited output
checks.code:
identification division.
program-id. museum.
procedure division.
display function upper-case("museum")
goback.

checks.name: COBOL multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code:
identification division.
program-id. museum.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 line-in pic X(128).
procedure division.
perform 2 times
 accept line-in
 display "[" function trim(line-in trailing) "]"
end-perform
goback.

checks.name: COBOL compile error prevents execution
checks.code:
identification division.
program-id. museum.
procedure division.
display "MUST_NOT_RUN"
add 1 to .

checks.name: COBOL missing runtime module is an error
checks.code:
identification division.
program-id. museum.
procedure division.
call "museum_missing_subprogram"
goback.

checks.name: COBOL timeout
checks.code:
identification division.
program-id. museum.
procedure division.
perform until 1 = 2 continue end-perform
goback.
